failure_modes: Damage to bystanders during the lag
Long cycles that exhaust patient capital
gloss: Unverifiable claims run on fear of missing out until markets demand proof
mechanism: When claims cannot be verified and no editor or filter checks them, belief spreads through fear of missing out and profit motive. Because stocks are purchases of future profit at a discount, the same dynamic is built into markets. Correction comes slowly, when a company fails to deliver and goes out of business, and may harm many before it arrives.
